goal: Add an independent source-to-lesson coverage reviewer, correct shared agent guidance for concise mid/senior teaching with separate assessments, and remove the user-rejected Database result files.

in_scope: Review modules/database/curriculum/database-module.md against the pinned Primer Database topic map and preserve the findings in this task worklog and reusable shared agent/skill procedures; do not edit the curriculum plan itself.

Create a shared curriculum-coverage-review skill and thin Codex and Claude coverage-reviewer profiles that independently compare planned topics and actual taught lesson content against the source repository.

Update curriculum-design, lesson-authoring, assessment-design, pedagogical-review, task-intake, and module-pipeline skills to preserve the user’s English-only, middle/senior, concise, teaching-first direction and require plan-stage and post-authoring coverage gates.
Update curriculum-designer, lesson-author, and pedagogy-reviewer provider profiles only to reference the shared procedures and clarify role boundaries.

Delete the exact user-rejected generated Database lessons, case study, assessment blueprint, QA report, and prior run result files listed in acceptance criterion ac-delete-results; preserve plan, source registry, governance, run inputs, task specs, states, and worklogs.
Run repository-required validation and record exact commands and outcomes in the task worklog; do not create another learner-facing or course-result artifact.
out_of_scope: Editing the Database curriculum plan, README, source registry, governance, or any remaining learner-facing content.
Authoring replacement Database lessons, exercises, quizzes, QA reports, or review reports.
Changing taskctl production behavior or tests.
Merging, publishing, approving, or opening a pull request.

constraints: Use @czyboi as the single writer and follow the persistent task protocol; Issue #5 is the coordination record and this file is canonical.
The current course target is middle/senior engineers learning system design; learner-facing course content is English-only. Follow newer explicit user direction if it changes either choice.

Teach in the lesson artifact; put the practical exercise, 5–8 knowledge checks, answers, rubric, and outcome mapping in a separate companion assessment artifact. The paired package collectively satisfies repository lesson requirements.
Keep prose concise and decision-focused for experienced learners; assume common backend, SQL, and application fundamentals unless the task spec says otherwise.
Treat the pinned System Design Primer commit ae9bbd7b02d90b9866215de185217d33f39ab733 as a topic map and licensed source, not as the sole technical authority.
Provider profiles must remain thin wrappers over shared skills. Do not duplicate shared procedures in profiles.
Delete only enumerated generated result files; preserve original inputs, plans, policies, task records, and workflow input snapshots.
Do not claim a course plan is complete or ready for authoring while material source-topic gaps remain unexplained. Keep generated lesson status draft and approval/publication human-controlled.

definition_of_done.text: A new shared coverage-review procedure and both provider profiles define independent plan-stage and actual-lesson audits, source-topic inventory, teaching-evidence classification, material-gap escalation, concise audience calibration, and a human-review-only verdict.

Shared planning, authoring, assessment, pedagogy, and intake procedures record English-only middle/senior direction; require concise teaching in the lesson artifact and separate outcome-aligned exercise/checks/answers in a companion artifact.
The pipeline blocks authoring on unresolved plan coverage gaps, requires a post-authoring coverage audit of actual teaching, and captures feedback/root cause/disposition in durable records.
Every exact rejected generated result path in ac-delete-results is absent; curriculum plan, source material, governance, run inputs, and task records are present and unchanged.
The required dependency installation, content validator, complete unittest suite, and taskctl validator are run and their exact outcomes are recorded without implying content approval.
All declared shared-skill/profile outputs and task records are committed, task automation reaches automation_complete, the worktree is clean, and no approval, merge, or publication state is inferred.

acceptance_criteria.text: The coverage-review skill requires a source-to-curriculum and source-to-actual-teaching matrix with exact source locator and lesson section, taught/merged/mention-only/assessment-only/planned-not-taught/omitted classification, explicit scope rationale, and severity. A title, reference, or quiz item alone never counts as teaching.

The pipeline uses the reviewer before authoring to audit the plan and after authoring to audit actual lesson files; a material unexplained gap blocks the next stage and curriculum designer self-review cannot replace the independent reviewer.

The retained plan is reviewed and the worklog records: federation appears only in the curriculum rationale; DB-04 maps primary/replica but not multi-writer replication; DB-02 covers indexes/query plans but does not define the broader SQL-tuning scope. The skill must generalize this audit beyond these examples.

Shared skills and relevant profiles encode the current middle/senior audience, English-only learner-facing content, concise decision-focused teaching, and separation between lesson teaching and companion assessment artifacts.

The shared pipeline procedure explains how to honor explicit rejection by deleting only enumerated generated outputs, preserving source/plan/task history and immutable inputs, and recording resulting stale task states rather than reusing rejected artifacts.
